content:
Priya: FYI Nomad is evaluating Redwood to replace RivalAPI. Primary asks: a clean adapter path, prompt/response parity validation, and answers to their security questionnaire. Can we scope a POC?
Noah: We should be pragmatic: 10 business day POC with three pillars: connectivity + questionnaire, adapter + smoke, and parity evaluation + pricing.
Diego: POC offer: hosted credits for testing, plus optional reserved trial pricing if they commit. Need token delta estimate to firm up numbers.
Mei: Security asks up-front: SOC2, DPA/SCC, KMS integration (customer key), IP allow lists, and retention policy. Also they require an incident response contact. ETA for questionnaire completion once we have SRE contact: 48h.
Kasey: Compatibility note: RivalAPI uses a legacy function-calling envelope: "result": {"name":..., "args":...} vs Redwood uses tool_call. Adapter has to normalize that and preserve call ordering. Also Rival tokenization assumes different token splitting for escaped characters; expect token variance 4-9% on average.
Noah: For parity tests we should A/B the same prompt set through Rival and Redwood and compute: embedding cosine, top-k response overlap, function-call match rate, and token delta. Capture latency percentiles too.
Priya: Nomad's blockers: they need private network for any customer PII, legal wants DPA/SCCs signed before any production traffic, and procurement asks for a 30-day termination clause.
Diego: We can do private VPC peering with Azure/AWS. For POC we can host in our staging tenant with strict retention (24h) if they give hashed identifiers. Production will require Private.
infra-bot: Staging adapter image built: redwood/adapter:v2-staging. To deploy for POC we need cloud account ID, allowed CIDRs, and expected QPS.
Mei: Legal-Bot: flag about procurement?
Legal-Bot: Standard DPA and SCCs are available. For termination and payment terms we can offer a 30-day cancellation window on trial contracts. Escalate any unusual clauses to Legal.
Kasey: Quick adapter sketch for the team:
```
transformRequest(req) {
  // map model header
  out.headers['X-Redwood-Model'] = modelMap(req.headers['X-Rival-Model'])
  out.body = normalizeFunctionEnvelope(req.body)
  out.meta = {migration: 'rival->redwood'}
}
```
We'll also log pre/post token counts to compute billing delta.
Noah: Edge cases for eval: streaming chunk boundaries, multiple nested function calls, stop-sequence handling, and rate-limit behavior. Include 30 function-call prompts and 20 streaming prompts.
Priya: Action items: 1) Priya to get Nomad SRE and prompt corpus (~400 samples). 2) Diego to draft pricing ranges and trial credits. 3) Mei to start the security questionnaire. 4) Kasey & Noah to build adapter + evaluation harness. Kickoff this Thursday, smoke in 4 business days.
Jordan (Nomad): I'll drop SRE contact (harper@nomad.co) and a redacted prompt set by EOD. PII: only hashed customer IDs for POC; production will include unredacted PII so private is required.
Mei: Noted. If PII is hashed we can start hosted with 24h retention for POC; production requires VPC and BYOK.
Diego: I'll prepare a ballpark price matrix (hosted PAYG, 6mo reserved, private infra+support) and post it here tomorrow.
Kasey: One more note: Rival has different default stop tokens which causes earlier truncation on some prompts. We'll include stop-token alignment tests in the harness.
Priya: Thanks team. Once we have the SRE contact and prompt corpus I'll circulate the runbook and the deployment checklist. :white_check_mark:
